$comment: Shared design tokens. Source of truth for iPhone (ios/Design/Tokens.swift), desktop/web (tokens.css) and the website. Look: app-sketch.html (approved 2026-10-11). Spec: design-system.md (older brutal spec; colours and fonts here win).
name: Mocha & Ollie

accentFor.$comment: Which accent a section, area or collection uses. 'yellow' is the name of the primary slot, now Ollie's sage.

border.$comment: No outlines. Focal cards get a dashed stitch inset 6 from the edge.

shadow.$comment: Soft, only on floating things (+ button, tab bar).

font.$comment: DM Sans for everything, 18 max on phone except big numbers. Lora medium italic for the gratitude question and prayer text.

components.card: Mocha (paper) fill, radius 20, no outline, no shadow.
components.focalCard: Exactly one per screen (Today's top task, top prayer): cream fill, cream ink, dashed stitch outline.
components.stitch: 1.5 dashed line inset 6 inside a card, stitch colour.
components.button: Pill. Primary = accent (sage) with onAccent text; secondary = chip fill.
components.addButton: 48 round sage +, soft shadow, above the tab bar.
components.chip: Pill, chip fill (or accent at 26%), semibold 12.
components.floatingTabBar: Tab-bar-coloured pill, height 54, radius 27, 14 from the sides; five 40pt round icons, selected = accent circle.
components.check: 20 circle with ring outline; done = green fill with dark tick.
components.progress: 10 high rounded track (chip), accent fill; optional green goal marker.
components.ollie: Only the PNG poses (ios Resources/Ollie): sit=Today, hug=Support, stand=Prayer, sleep=Tasks done, side=More. Never redraw him; he encourages, never speaks for God.

brand.$comment: App name chosen 2026-10-11: hesent.me. Read it from here, never hard-code it.

folderTab.$comment: Right edge slants outward going down. Normalised path from the desktop card.
